claude.rationale: gap_45=1: the customer-facing asset (mineral properties, T4) did NOT change ownership — "Title to the Assets shall be held by EML and G8 as equal cotenants" (EX-2.1 §3.4) — yet the producing/exploring PROCESS crossed to the Hecla side, with RGS as operator/Manager who "shall manage, direct and control Operations" (§8.1), a documented product-vs-process split at closing. gap_56=1: operatorship (T5) transferred to RGS/Hecla while the filings "disclose no transfer of employees, management, or an organization from EML/G8 to the Hecla side," so process re-assignment occurred without organization/people (T6) transferring alongside. gap_mitigated=yes: a closing-era Hecla conditional limited guaranty capped at $2,500,000 was documented as the "closing-era mechanism bridging the parties' shared substrate," together with the Management Committee governance allocating the shared substrate. T1 coded imprint-share because both principals' intent remain co-present (EML/G8 retain 50/50 title, RGS earns in as operator).

gemini.rationale: At closing, title to the mineral properties (T4) remained with EML and G8, while operatorship and management of operations (T5) were transferred to RGS, creating a structural mismatch (gap_45). Furthermore, RGS assumed operations (T5) without any disclosed transfer of EML/G8 personnel or organization (T6), resulting in gap_56. These gaps were contractually mitigated by the joint venture operating agreement and a conditional limited guaranty provided by Hecla.

grok.rationale: gap_45 is 0 because the slice states the customer-facing mineral properties (T4) did not change hands at closing—title remained with EML and G8 as equal cotenants under EX-2.1 §3.4/§5.1—while operatorship moved; the defined product-without-process mismatch is therefore absent. gap_56 is 1 because operatorship/process (T5) crossed to RGS as initial operator/Manager with authority to manage, direct and control Operations (EX-2.1 §8.1–§8.2), yet the filings disclose no transfer of employees, management, or organization (T6) from EML/G8. That process-without-organization gap was contractually absorbed at closing by the Exploration, Development and Mine Operating Agreement plus the Hecla conditional limited guaranty allocating the shared substrate.
